title: User email/login uniqueness checks request key-only FIELD_VALUES search
answers: How does Grafana check if a user's email or login is already taken?
Why does createUserSearchRequest only ask for resource.SEARCH_FIELD_NAME?
Changing fields requested in user validation search
body: validateEmail/validateLogin in pkg/registry/apis/iam/user/validate.go build a search request via createUserSearchRequest that now requests only resource.SEARCH_FIELD_NAME with ResultFormat: FIELD_VALUES instead of fetching fieldEmail/fieldLogin rows, since only the matched resource's name/key is needed to decide if the match is the same user being created/updated (Mode 2 dual-write case). If you need additional fields back from this search, add them to createUserSearchRequest's Fields and update firstUserSearchResultName's FIELD_VALUES branch accordingly, since that function assumes name is the only field populated.
says: Duplicate email check when creating new accounts
User creation rejects email without valid reason
System should prevent duplicate login names
Email uniqueness validation during sign up
Cannot register with email already in use
search: User email/login uniqueness checks via validateEmail/validateLogin in pkg/registry/apis/iam/user/validate.go must use createUserSearchRequest that requests only resource.SEARCH_FIELD_NAME with ResultFormat FIELD_VALUES, retrieving only the matched resource's name to determine uniqueness in Mode 2 dual-write scenarios. If additional fields are needed from the search result, update both createUserSearchRequest's Fields list and firstUserSearchResultName's FIELD_VALUES branch, since that function assumes name is the only populated field. This pattern avoids fetching full fieldEmail/fieldLogin rows when only the key is needed for duplicate detection.
